rules.source: Personal Data Protection Law No. 29733 (2011) — sets rules for lawful, fair, and secure processing of personal data in both public and private sectors; organizations must register with Peru's National Authority for the Protection of Personal Data (ANPD), part of the Ministry of Justice and Human Rights. https://securiti.ai/peru-data-protection-law/

Consumer Protection Code, Law No. 29571 — safeguards consumer rights (fair treatment, product safety) and separately regulates processing of personal data for commercial purposes, operating alongside Law No. 29733. https://www.smartsuite.com/framework/peru-personal-data-protection-law-no-29733
